project_title: Factory Profit & Loss Panel - Oman Manufacturing

font_rules.headings: Use Outfit with tracking-tight and font-semibold or font-bold. DO NOT use Inter for main headings.
font_rules.numbers_and_tables: Use font-mono (JetBrains Mono) or tabular-nums class for clear vertical alignment of financial amounts.
font_rules.body: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for UI controls, body text, form labels, and standard text.

scale.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50

layout_architecture.viewport: Desktop first, 1280px minimum target, responsive down to 1024px.

sidebar.style: bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 border-r border-slate-800 flex flex-col h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 z-40 overflow-y-auto
sidebar.brand_header: px-6 py-5 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between font-semibold text-white tracking-wide text-lg
sidebar.nav_group_title: px-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 mb-2 mt-4
sidebar.nav_item_active: bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center gap-3 transition-colors shadow-sm
sidebar.nav_item_inactive: text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center gap-3 transition-colors

topbar.style: h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 pl-72 pr-8 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-xs

kpi_cards.structure: Grid of 5 cards (col-span-1 on 5-col grid or 3+2 layout). Clean white card, 1px border border-slate-200, rounded-xl p-5 shadow-xs transition-hover hover:border-slate-300.

charts.trend_chart: Recharts Area/Line chart for 12-month historical performance with 3 distinct series: Revenue (#0284C7), Total Costs (#E11D48), Net Profit (#059669). Rounded tooltip card with backdrop-blur and full OMR 3-decimal precision.
charts.expense_chart: Recharts Bar chart horizontal breakdown of Operating Expenses with hover highlighters.
charts.revenue_vs_cost: Recharts Dual Line/Area chart comparing total cash inflow vs outflow.

data_entry_table.container: White card background, rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-xs
data_entry_table.header_toolbar: p-4 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between
data_entry_table.summary_banner: bg-slate-900 text-white p-4 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between font-mono font-medium text-sm mt-4

modals_and_forms.dialog_style: Shadcn Dialog with max-w-lg bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xl
modals_and_forms.input_style: h-10 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-blue-600 transition-all font-mono
modals_and_forms.date_picker: Shadcn Popover with Calendar component or structured input, formatted to DD MMM YYYY.

reports_view.filters: Date range picker (Start Date, End Date) + Daily/Monthly toggle switch. Instant validation error if Start Date > End Date.
reports_view.summary_p_and_l_table: Hierarchical financial statement view with collapsible/indented category rows and bold Total / Net Profit bottom calculation row.
reports_view.cost_per_unit_table: Calculates (Raw Material Consumption + Direct Labour + Machine Running Cost) / Finished Goods Produced Units = Cost Per Unit (OMR).

settings_view.dialog_confirm: Shadcn AlertDialog requiring typing 'CONFIRM' before execution of clear sample data action.

testing_attributes.rule: Mandatory data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, metric card, modal trigger, table row, and chart container.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 3-decimal currency rule for OMR: e.g. 'OMR 1,234.567'. Use a helper function `formatOMR(amount)` everywhere.
Losses MUST be prefixed with a minus sign and styled in red: e.g., '-OMR 450.000' with class `text-rose-600 bg-rose-50`.
Dates must always render in 'DD MMM YYYY' format (e.g., '12 NOV 2026'). Use date-fns or custom formatter.
Ensure the sidebar cleanly groups the 18 data entry categories into 4 sections: Revenue, COGS, Operating Expenses, Other.
Include empty states with message 'No data for this period' when date ranges have zero entries.
Ensure 'start > end' date validation triggers a prominent toast alert or inline error message in Reports.
All interactive and metric components must include `data-testid` attributes.
Ensure high contrast and clean presentation suitable for desktop manufacturing finance admins.
